Tyrunt

Rock Dragon

Kalos · Generation 6

Tyrunt is a Rock/Dragon-type Royal Heir Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 26 kg. It evolves into Tyrantrum. Its highest base stat is Attack (89), with a base stat total of 362.
